title: Sin Separates Us from God

questions.question: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, or his ear dull, that it cannot what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:1 (ESV): "or his ear dull, that it cannot hear;"

questions.question: But your iniquities have made a separation between you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you so that he does not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:2 (ESV): "so that he does not hear."

questions.question: For your hands are defiled with blood and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies; your tongue mutters what?
They hatch adders' eggs; they weave the spider's web; he who eats their eggs dies, and from one that is crushed a viper is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:5 (ESV): "and from one that is crushed a viper is hatched."

questions.question: Their webs will not serve as clothing; men will not cover themselves with what they make. Their works are works of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:6 (ESV): "Their works are works of iniquity,"

questions.question: Their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed innocent blood; their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:7 (ESV): "desolation and destruction are in their highways."

questions.question: The way of peace they do not know, and there is no justice in their paths; they have made their roads crooked; no one who treads on them knows what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:8 (ESV): "no one who treads on them knows peace."

questions.question: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not overtake us; we hope for light, and behold, darkness, and for brightness, but we walk in what?
We grope for the wall like the blind; we grope like those who have no eyes; we stumble at noon as in the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:10 (ESV): "we stumble at noon as in the twilight,"

questions.question: We all growl like bears; we moan and moan like doves; we hope for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far from what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:11 (ESV): "but it is far from us."

questions.question: The LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice. He saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no one to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:16 (ESV): "and wondered that there was no one to intercede;"

questions.question: Then his own arm brought him salvation, and his righteousness upheld him. He put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation on his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:17 (ESV): "and a helmet of salvation on his head;"

questions.question: He put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and wrapped himself in zeal as a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:17 (ESV): "and wrapped himself in zeal as a cloak."

questions.question: So they shall fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come like a rushing stream, which the wind of the LORD what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:19 (ESV): "which the wind of the LORD drives."

questions.question: "And a Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression," declares the LORD. "And as for me, this is my covenant with them," says the LORD: "My Spirit that is upon you, and my words that I have put in your mouth, shall not depart out of your mouth, or out of the mouth of your offspring, or out of the mouth of your children's offspring," says the LORD, "from this time forth and..."
questions.explanation: Isaiah 59:21 (ESV): "from this time forth and forevermore."

key_verse_text: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save, or his ear dull, that it cannot hear; but your iniquities have made a separation between you and your God, and your sins have hidden his face from you so that he does not hear.
